claim: The 639 candidates were pooled from three source conditions and nine trajectory/seed branches.
The sampling is stage-balanced for failure attribution and is not time-weighted.
The paired comparison contains 12 canonical checkpoints with explicit lineage and hashes.
All 7,668 paired static evaluations are finite and successful.
Force disagreement increases from stable controls toward precursor and threshold structures.
All candidate stages fall outside the training SOAP q99 envelope and are separated from the NEB reference region.
Static model disagreement does not prove which force is physically correct or causally responsible for MD instability.
Reduced PBC-preserving fragments are required before DFT correctness can be tested.
The four-panel figure is a new Plot Atlas reconstruction from verified processed data.
